title: Day Trip to Thomson's Falls
culturalNote: Thomson's Falls (Maporomoko ya Thomson) plunge 74 metres off the Aberdare range at Nyahururu, one of Kenya's highest towns, surrounded by tea and potato farms. Guides here switch between Kikuyu, Swahili and English all day. Upcountry farmers typically "hulima" (grow) potatoes and maize and "hufuga" (keep) cattle — the habitual hu- is perfect for talking about how people live. Locals love visitors who try their Swahili.
